title: Shortage Detection (automatic)

purpose.en: How a short delivery is found after production. Shortage = net material issued minus (good output plus standard waste), in the material unit. A gap above the PO tolerance becomes a Draft shortage request.
purpose.id: Cara kurang kirim ditemukan setelah produksi. Kekurangan = bahan keluar bersih dikurangi (output baik ditambah waste standar), dalam satuan bahan. Selisih di atas toleransi PO menjadi permintaan kirim kekurangan Draft.

keywords: kurang kirim otomatis, deteksi kurang kirim, shortage detection, detect shortage, inv:detect-shortage, output produksi, waste standar, toleransi po

steps.en: Run php artisan inv:detect-shortage, or add --wo=<id> for one work order and --dry-run to only look. Add -v to see why a pair was skipped.
steps.id: Jalankan php artisan inv:detect-shortage, atau tambah --wo=<id> untuk satu WO dan --dry-run untuk hanya melihat. Tambah -v untuk melihat alasan pasangan dilewati.

steps.en: Good output in the material unit = the material need of the work order times (good output of the last operation divided by the work order quantity).
steps.id: Output baik dalam satuan bahan = kebutuhan bahan WO dikali (output baik operasi terakhir dibagi qty WO).

steps.en: That need already holds the standard waste of all steps, so the check leans to not accusing. Waste above the standard is a usage variance, not a shortage.
steps.id: Kebutuhan itu sudah memuat waste standar semua langkah, jadi pemeriksaan condong tidak menuduh. Waste di atas standar adalah varians pemakaian, bukan kurang kirim.

steps.en: A pair is skipped, and stays a typed entry, when the work order is not finished, has no output, has a material need of 0, uses another unit, or the issue has no batch.
steps.id: Pasangan dilewati, dan tetap diketik manual, bila WO belum selesai, tanpa output, kebutuhan bahan 0, satuannya lain, atau keluar bahan tanpa batch.

steps.en: A Draft request is made once per work order and material. The head of the warehouse gets a notice to recount.
steps.id: Permintaan Draft dibuat sekali per WO dan bahan. Kepala gudang menerima pemberitahuan untuk menghitung ulang.

title: Shortage Follow-up Documents

purpose.en: What is made when a shortage request moves on: notices to the roles, an extra purchase request when PPIC confirms, and a draft debit note when the supplier refuses or the window lapses.
purpose.id: Apa yang dibuat saat permintaan kirim kekurangan berjalan: pemberitahuan ke peran terkait, PR tambahan saat PPIC mengonfirmasi, dan draft debit note saat pemasok menolak atau jendela lewat.

keywords: pr tambahan, debit note, potong tagihan, kurang kirim, pemberitahuan, notifikasi, backorder, additional purchase request

steps.en: New request: the head of the warehouse is notified. After the recount PPIC is notified. After Confirm Purchasing and PPIC are notified.
steps.id: Permintaan baru: kepala gudang diberi tahu. Setelah hitung ulang PPIC diberi tahu. Setelah Confirm Pembelian dan PPIC diberi tahu.

steps.en: Confirm for a supplier receipt also makes a Draft purchase request for the shortfall. Use that request or the reopened PO line, not both.
steps.id: Confirm untuk penerimaan supplier juga membuat PR Draft untuk kekurangannya. Pakai PR itu atau baris PO yang dibuka lagi, jangan keduanya.

steps.en: The request takes the department and account of the PO line. Without them no request is made and a note says so.
steps.id: PR memakai departemen dan akun dari baris PO. Tanpa keduanya PR tidak dibuat dan catatan menyebutnya.

steps.en: Refuse, or Close Lapsed, closes the PO line at the received quantity and makes a Draft debit note: quantity times the price of the receipt line. Customer material gets none.
steps.id: Refuse, atau Close Lapsed, menutup baris PO di qty terima dan membuat draft debit note: qty dikali harga baris penerimaan. Bahan customer tidak mendapat debit note.

steps.en: The debit note is a simple draft. It has no journal yet.
steps.id: Debit note ini draft sederhana. Belum ada jurnalnya.

title: Quality Decision Escalation

purpose.en: Batches that stay Conditional or in Quarantine without a quality decision are reported. After INV_QC_ESCALATE_HOURS the head of QC and operations managers are notified; after INV_QC_DEADLINE_HOURS a usage decision is required.
purpose.id: Batch yang tetap Conditional atau Quarantine tanpa keputusan mutu dilaporkan. Lewat INV_QC_ESCALATE_HOURS kepala QC dan operations manager diberi tahu; lewat INV_QC_DEADLINE_HOURS usage decision wajib.

keywords: eskalasi qc, tenggat keputusan, conditional, quarantine, inv:qc-escalate, usage decision, kepala qc, ops manager

steps.en: Run php artisan inv:qc-escalate. Add --dry-run to list the batches without sending. It is not scheduled yet.
steps.id: Jalankan php artisan inv:qc-escalate. Tambah --dry-run untuk melihat daftar batch tanpa mengirim. Belum dijadwalkan.

steps.en: Past the escalate hours: head of QC and operations manager. Past the deadline hours: also QA and PPIC.
steps.id: Lewat jam eskalasi: kepala QC dan operations manager. Lewat jam tenggat: ditambah QA dan PPIC.

steps.en: Each batch gets one notice per stage, so the command can run again and again.
steps.id: Tiap batch mendapat satu pemberitahuan per tahap, jadi perintah ini aman dijalankan berulang.

steps.en: A supplier with a confirmed shortage or a reject of any kind is sampled Tightened until enough lots pass after it.
steps.id: Supplier dengan kurang kirim yang dikonfirmasi atau reject jenis apa pun disampel Tightened sampai cukup lot lulus sesudahnya.
